breakdown.description: `ICHARG = 11` freezes the charge density even though the Step 2 note says the HSE run must recompute it and therefore `ICHARG` cannot exceed 10.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification sets ICHARG = 1 instead of the incorrect ICHARG = 11 from the incomplete prompt. ICHARG = 1 is ≤ 10, which satisfies the requirement that ICHARG cannot exceed 10 so the charge density is recomputed during the HSE calculation. This aligns with the ground truth's ICHARG = 0.
